This week we listened to two artists. The first artist talked about toys. He said a technology can be a toy first, and a tool later. A toy is open. It has no rules and no winner, so the player can play in their own way. A game has rules and a winner. He said a good toy has the right size for the hand, feels good to touch, and can move. He also gave Barbie as an example. I loved playing with this toy when I was a child.

The second artist talked about maps. She said a map is not neutral. A map can show time, and it also has power. One example was a fake road sign in Beijing. Later, the maps included it, so it became real. Other examples showed that different map shapes tell different stories, and people without a voice can draw their own maps.
title: week4
introduction: This week we had a lecture. Two artists came to share their ideas, and they talked about toys and maps.
